hints: Focus on how an ester splits in acid hydrolysis, the acid always comes from the carbonyl (C=O) side, not the O-alkyl side.
Propanoic acid is $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{COOH}$, so look for an ester whose C=O carbon is attached to an ethyl group, giving 3 carbons in total for the acid part.
Count the carbons attached to the C=O in each structure and match the one that gives a 2-carbon chain plus the carbonyl carbon.
walkthrough:
**Recall acid hydrolysis of esters**

Think of an ester as acid part joined to alcohol part. With dilute acid and water it splits back apart.

Chemical equation rule:
$$\text{RCOOR' + H}_2\text{O} \xrightarrow{\text{H}^+} \text{RCOOH + R'OH}$$

**Identify what we need for propanoic acid**

Propanoic acid has 3 carbons in total, including the carboxyl carbon.

Target acid:
$$\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{COOH}$$

**Check the carbonyl side of each ester**

The group attached directly to the $\text{C=O}$ becomes the $\text{R}$ in $\text{RCOOH}$. We need $\text{R = CH}_3\text{CH}_2$ (ethyl).

Only the ester with $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{-C(=O)-O-CH}_2\text{CH}_3$ has an ethyl group on the carbonyl side, so on hydrolysis it gives propanoic acid plus ethanol.

options.A: This is ethyl propanoate, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{COOCH}_2\text{CH}_3$. The carbonyl side is $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{C=O}$, so acid hydrolysis gives $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{COOH}$ (propanoic acid) + ethanol. This matches exactly.
options.B: This is ethyl 2-methylpropanoate, with a branched $(\text{CH}_3)_2\text{CH-C=O}$ group. Hydrolysis gives 2-methylpropanoic acid, not propanoic acid. Trap is counting total carbons instead of looking specifically at the acid side.
options.C: This is propyl ethanoate, $\text{CH}_3\text{COOCH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_3$. The carbonyl side is only $\text{CH}_3\text{C=O}$, so it gives ethanoic acid + propan-1-ol. Trap is confusing the 3-carbon alcohol side with the acid side.
options.D: This is ethyl butanoate, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{COOCH}_2\text{CH}_3$. The carbonyl side has 3 carbons plus the carbonyl carbon, so it gives butanoic acid + ethanol. Trap is miscounting the chain on the C=O side by one carbon.
